correctness.rationale: The four families consist of nonzero real homogeneous harmonics: the horizontal powers of x1+i x2 are harmonic, and multiplying a horizontal harmonic by x3 preserves harmonicity. Their complexifications are sums or differences of powers of x1+i x2 and x1-i x2, optionally multiplied by x3; a uniform neighborhood with those two magnitudes bounded by rho<sqrt(2) yields geometric normal convergence of the kernel series. For strictness at arbitrary finite sites the nonnegative series for the Gram form must vanish feature by feature if the form is zero. For each of the two projection weight families A_z and B_z, the real and imaginary moments on long blocks are ordinary power moments on the distinct nonzero nodes in U union conjugate(U), with coefficients proportional to A_z plus or minus A_conjugate(z) (or B). Separate Vandermonde inversion on each block is valid because its exponent shift multiplies each column by a nonzero power. This proves both projected weight families vanish off zero; degrees zero and one resolve the zero projection, and distinct heights in every two-point fibre resolve individual coefficients. The operator's restriction to degree n is exactly 2^-n times the rank-one operator of F_n, by harmonic orthogonality. Normalized longitude averaging and integration in height give the two stated beta factors (B(1/2,n+1)/4 and B(3/2,n)/4); degrees zero and one give 1 and 1/6. The x1 probability perturbations are orthogonal to all features, establishing identical embeddings and non-universality. Inspected RESULT.md, VERIFICATION.md and check.py without running the supplied diagnostic; no numerical bound or generic-position assumption is needed.

evidence: The Jäger and Buhmann–Jäger sufficient tests require strictly positive degree operators in infinitely many even and odd degrees. The near-complete-support criterion of Guella–Jäger does not follow from retaining only one mode and omitting 2n in every degree n.

evidence: The rational two-series construction uses both u^k and x3 u^k moments for all k, relying on the same fibre geometry. It reports failure after deleting either entire series. The one-real-mode result schedules four real families in disjoint increasing blocks and proves why retaining only the staggered moments suffices.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: This shares the underlying separation mechanism with the same-day comparator, but preserving separability after the much stronger restriction does not follow from strict positivity of the full two-series Gram form. It needs the nonzero-node shifted-block argument, along with separate degree-zero and degree-one treatment.

value.rationale: The construction attains the smallest positive rank possible in each represented degree while guaranteeing interpolation at every finite collection, a stringent benchmark for nonisotropic strict-positivity criteria. It also gives a concrete and explicit separation between finite-site strictness and characteristicness/universality. This does not assert that all degrees must be represented in other strictly positive definite kernels.
